name: ant-arena

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist

description: Ant Arena — white-label daily quizzes, live quiz games, live polls and certification for companies.
